game_title: Strip And Replace – Blizzard Saddle Rush
game_concept: A action puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Blizzard Saddle, a saddle between peaks: the mountaineer must handle crevasse ghouls while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Strip And Replace: Clean messy text with strip() and replace() before the scribes read it.
theme: Frost Peaks – Blizzard Saddle: a saddle between peaks
core_gameplay_loop: In Blizzard Saddle, repeat each round: Clean messy text with strip() and replace() before the scribes read it. Each round, a new flares challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the clean_text value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 290 points of flares by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 290, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 4 (applied tier): Strip And Replace
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Strip And Replace' (Week 8 slot 14), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Blizzard Saddle'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how clean_text changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against crevasse ghouls in Blizzard Saddle.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 290 within 31 seconds.
